label: Counting ray crossings
subgoals: Cast a horizontal ray from the query point
Count the vertical edges it crosses to the right
Classify the point by the parity of the count

label: Testing many points
subgoals: Reject points outside the bounding box first
Count crossings for each remaining point
Total the points with odd crossing counts

label: Even-odd versus nonzero winding
subgoals: Compute the winding number as the count of covering counter-clockwise rings
Apply the nonzero rule and the even-odd rule
Find the points where coverage is even and positive
